sections.title: Which role fits you?
sections.text: ATHA looks for five key team functions: domain expertise, AI feasibility, responsible AI, business viability, and communication. Your degree can hint at your fit, but we match you based on what you can actually do and what excites you. It’s about skills, not just subjects.

sections.title: What is ATHA, really?
sections.text: ATHA brings together education, research, industry, and talent to tackle real-world challenges with AI — not just as a tool, but as a partner in smarter, healthier innovation. We believe breakthroughs shouldn’t come at the cost of burnout or losing human judgment. Instead, we design experiences where people and AI create together, responsibly and joyfully.

sections.title: How are teams formed?
sections.text: Teams are built around five core functions, with at least one AI-capable member in each. We look for a balance of skills — not just five experts in the same thing. You’ll share your strengths, and we’ll shape teams from the actual pool, making sure rare talents like AI ability are placed first.

sections.title: Why does ATHA exist — what makes it different?
sections.text: ATHA exists to prove that AI innovation can be both powerful and human. We create experiences where people tackle real industry challenges, learn to judge AI wisely, and grow the skills needed for the future — all while feeling healthier, more connected, and more in control of their work.

sections.title: More context: What is ATHA?
sections.text: ATHA is an emerging initiative focused on AI-native innovation experiences.

sections.title: More context: Why does ATHA exist?
sections.text: ATHA exists to explore how AI can drive innovation in ways that support human flourishing.

sections.title: The current state of the first ATHA edition
sections.text: The first edition is shaping up with around 45 selected participants, centred at Warwick. They’ll form nine multidisciplinary teams of five, each tackling one of three real enterprise AI challenges. Three teams will work on each challenge, based at Warwick Business School, with Warwick and Coventry as the core hub.

sections.title: The arc every ATHA edition follows
sections.text: Each ATHA edition unfolds in seven stages: arrive and settle in, open and sense the challenge, connect across disciplines, create through AI-native investigation, discern with depth, celebrate diverse excellence, and integrate insights to carry forward.

sections.title: The three partners and their roles
sections.text: OneMundi leads as initiator and owner, bringing the AI-native methodology and ecosystem vision. Warwick Business School provides the academic setting, participants, research, and institutional grounding. Hadora shapes the human layer — rhythm, safety, and integration — as the experience design behind ATHA.
